verdict: Organic activity is softening across all three locations; paid remains dark.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all 402 Google Business Profile actions this period came entirely from organic sources — no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google Ads at any location. GBP engagement fell week-over-week at every location (down 36% at Forte, 27% at Advance Grinding, and 55% at O'Hare Precision), pointing to a broad dip in local search demand or a ranking shift rather than an isolated issue. Search visibility on the web side is being investigated, with a root-cause finding and fix targeted for submission by end of August. Web tracking is also being reconnected so that organic clicks are visible all the way through to pipeline, not just at the search level.

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement has dropped week-over-week at all three locations simultaneously, with the sharpest fall at O'Hare Precision (down 55%); the last two to three days across locations recorded near-zero daily actions.
watch_item.fix: A search-visibility root-cause review is underway, with a fix targeted for submission by August 31 and site reindexing expected to show impression recovery by end of October.
